description: “I intend to run for Maine House District 45 because many constituents asked me to represent them,” Clinton Collamore of Waldoboro said in a statement.Collamore was elected to the seat in 2022 but resigned after making a mistake with Clean Elections paperwork. He said he collected some $5 donations from community members and later filled out the paperwork himself not realizing that wasn’t allowed. “It was an honest mistake for which I have paid dearly.” All the campaign money was paid back, and
paid_for_by: Paid for by Collamore for House bottom of page
